hypotheses.claim: L0 uses Trade unconditionally on every Zoroark every turn (up to 4/turn = discard 4 + draw 8), self-milling the ~47-card deck to 0 in ~4 turns and losing to deckout; also pitches combo pieces via the forced discard
hypotheses.direction: loss_share[deckout] must be LOW and far below the Trade-on baseline; Trade fires must be gated by deck depth (drop sharply as deckCount falls)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: stopping Trade too early starves the hand of energy/combo pieces -> can't reach D×2 or assemble copy-source -> tempo/brick loss (watch hand_size_dist not collapsing)
hypotheses.scenario: Mirror or any matchup: by ~T5 get 3-4 N's Zoroark ex in play; each turn activate Trade on all of them plus Ultra Ball/Cyrano searches; deckCount drops ~10-13/turn; player begins a turn with 0 cards -> RESULT reason=2 (deckout). Probe-observed: 24/40 games ended by deckout, 13 p0 deckout losses with Trade-on vs 0 with Trade-off.
hypotheses.pattern: 山戻し条件発火＋山薄時の掘り停止

hypotheses.claim: L0 attaches Darkness to the display-max Pokemon (Zekrom 250 / Reshiram 170) instead of the active copy-attacker Zoroark (display 0); Reshiram loading is pure waste (type-dead) and active Zoroark stays unarmed
hypotheses.direction: energy_attach_share[293] should dominate; share to 303 (Reshiram) should be ~0
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never loading Zekrom removes the emergency 70-damage (atk1305) line and the PP-Up->N's-Plan relay that pre-loads bench then moves energy to active
hypotheses.violation_symptom: エネが意図しないポケモンへ
hypotheses.pattern: デッキ固有の給餌計画(先貼り・キャップ・順序)

hypotheses.claim: Zoroark's copy attack displays 0 damage, so L0's damage-based logic (lethal check, promotion, energy allocation, gust) undervalues Zoroark and it under-attacks or is not prioritized as the wincon
hypotheses.direction: once Zoroark is in play with 2D, it should attack nearly every turn (nonattacking_turn_rate low)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing an attack when copy source is only Zorua (20) wastes a turn that could set up a real copy-source; perception must read the actual benched max, not a constant
hypotheses.violation_symptom: スケール技が過小評価される
hypotheses.pattern: 実打点式を共有知覚へ昇格

hypotheses.claim: Copying Zekrom 1306 (250) applies 'can't attack next turn' to Zoroark; with Zekrom benched the engine ALWAYS auto-copies 250 (max display), so uptime drops to every-other-turn unless a 2nd armed Zoroark is rotated in via free retreat / Switch
hypotheses.direction: on the turn after a 250-copy, the plan must retreat+attack with a 2nd Zoroark OR fall back to Reshiram-170; nonattacking_turn_rate must not spike to ~0.5
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forbidding 250 unless perfect rotation exists forfeits burst KOs on 280-HP exs where 170 can't close; keep 250 available when it secures a prize even at the cost of one idle turn
hypotheses.pattern: 2体目の予備装填(チェイン、上限つき)

hypotheses.claim: L0 treats a Darkness-loaded Reshiram/Munkidori as a 'loaded attacker' (won't retreat, may promote it after a KO) but both are TYPE-DEAD and can never attack -> soft-lock wall / donated tempo
hypotheses.metric: retreat_count, nonattacking_turn_rate (conditioned on active in {303,112}), first_attack_turn
hypotheses.direction: Reshiram(303)/Munkidori(112) must never be left active as an attacker; if stranded active, retreat/switch immediately

threshold.value: fraction of turns with active in {303,112} and no attack <= 0.05

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-eager retreats waste Switch/energy; only force the swap when the active literally cannot pay any of its own attacks with Darkness
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 型死ポケモンを装填扱い
hypotheses.pattern: 型対応の装填判定(数でなく型で壁と装填中を区別)

hypotheses.claim: Lillie's Determination is the deck's anti-deckout refuel (shuffles hand into deck, draws 6/8), but L0 fires draw supporters only at hand<=5; with Trade keeping the hand full, Lillie never fires when the DECK is low
hypotheses.metric: trigger_fire[lillie], hand_size_dist, deckCount at Lillie fire
hypotheses.direction: Lillie should fire when deckCount is low regardless of hand size (deck-refuel trigger, not hand-size trigger)

threshold.value: P(Lillie fires | deckCount <= R) high, R in {8..12}

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: firing Lillie too eagerly shuffles a strong assembled hand back into the deck, losing an in-hand combo turn (note: reshuffle, not loss)
hypotheses.pattern: 山戻しの条件発火＋山薄時の掘り停止

hypotheses.claim: L0 fires Ultra Ball / Poffin / Cyrano / Pokegear unconditionally each turn, thinning the deck even when nothing is needed (Poffin/Cyrano can't even fetch Zekrom/Reshiram: Poffin<=70HP, Cyrano ex-only) -> accelerates deckout
hypotheses.metric: play_rate[1121], play_rate[1086], play_rate[1205], correlation with deckCount
hypotheses.direction: search/ball play_rate must fall sharply as deckCount drops and when the target is already in hand/play

threshold.value: ball/search play_rate near 0 when deckCount <= K

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: throttling search too hard slows finding Zoroark line / copy source in the opening -> late first_attack_turn

hypotheses.claim: Boss's Orders / Prime Catcher gust value is huge with the real 250/500 copy, but L0 only gusts when its active's DISPLAY damage >= 60; Zoroark shows 0 so gust may never fire (value left on the table)
hypotheses.direction: Boss/Prime should fire when active Zoroark is armed and a benched opponent target is KO-able / prize-relevant

threshold.value: P(Boss fires | Zoroark armed AND KOable bench target) high

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: gusting before Zoroark is armed, or onto a non-KOable target, wastes the supporter turn (competes with N's Plan / Lillie for the 1 supporter slot)
hypotheses.pattern: サイド期待値・実打点ベースの対象選択

hypotheses.claim: Crushing Hammer (coin flip) and Budew (item lock) are situational disruption L0 may burn blindly: Hammer when opponent has no energy to strip, Budew when opponent is not item-dependent
hypotheses.metric: play_rate[1120], play_rate[235], trigger_fire on empty targets
hypotheses.direction: Hammer only when opponent has attachable energy on a threat; Budew only early vs item-reliant opponents
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never playing disruption forfeits real energy-denial / tempo vs setup decks
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 妨害カードの浪費/腐り

hypotheses.claim: L0 uses Munkidori Adrena-Brain unconditionally; it needs Darkness attached and only helps when own damage counters exist AND a useful opponent target exists, else it is a wasted ability activation (and can move counters off a Pokemon you wanted damaged for Reshiram-420, though the engine ignores 420 anyway)
hypotheses.direction: Adrena-Brain fires only when Munkidori has Darkness AND own damage counters exist AND moving them KOs/advances vs opponent
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-gating loses the snipe/finisher and the self-heal that keeps a damaged Zoroark alive
hypotheses.violation_symptom: 妨害カードの浪費/腐り
hypotheses.pattern: 自己害効果の無条件発火(盤面状態ゲート)
